display_long_description:
Welcome to Pet Care – Vet Hospital Simulator VR, a fun and immersive veterinary simulation game in VR where you become a real pet doctor and run your own animal hospital!

Step inside your fully interactive VR vet clinic and care for adorable pets including dogs, cats, and more. Diagnose illnesses, treat injuries, perform checkups, and use realistic medical tools to help your furry patients feel better.

🐾 Become a Real Vet in VR

Experience hands-on pet treatment using interactive medical equipment. Examine pets, check their symptoms, clean wounds, apply medicine, and complete engaging treatment procedures in a fully immersive virtual environment.

🏥 Manage Your Own Animal Hospital

Take responsibility for your growing veterinary clinic. Welcome new patients, guide them to treatment areas, and provide the best care to keep tails wagging and paws happy.

🐶 Treat Cute and Adorable Pets

Each animal has unique conditions and reactions. Stay attentive, follow the right steps, and become the most trusted pet doctor in town.

🎮 Casual & Relaxing Gameplay

Easy-to-learn mechanics make this a perfect VR simulation experience for players of all ages. Enjoy satisfying tasks, smooth controls, and rewarding pet care moments.

🌟 Immersive Virtual Reality Experience

Designed specifically for VR, interact naturally with tools, pets, and your clinic environment. Feel like you’re truly inside a real vet hospital.

If you love pet care games, veterinary simulators, animal doctor games,
